wywf.constructor.apply_help: Put the query in the Seed field and return to world creation
wywf.constructor.find_help: Search for seeds that match this query
wywf.constructor.marker_help: drag to move; right-click for settings
wywf.constructor.distance_only: Drag markers to set distance; right-click for settings. Directions are schematic.
wywf.constructor.choose: Select a target from either list
wywf.results.title: Found seeds
wywf.results.offline_help: World generation has not been verified. This candidate is based on offline filters.
wywf.results.distance_help: Verified distances and query ranges use the nearest edge of the rectangular structure area, measured from the search center. Coordinates identify the structure origin.
wywf.results.verify_all_hint: Check all collected seeds across every page
wywf.results.verify_failed_create: This seed failed server verification. Create the world anyway?
wywf.results.verify_totals: Server check: %d passed · %d rejected · %d incomplete · %d unchecked
wywf.map.title: Seed map
wywf.map.source: Vanilla noise biomes at the selected Y; standard Overworld. T is base biome temperature, not В°C. No surface heights or datapack preview.
wywf.map.controls: Wheel: zoom · Drag: pan · PgUp/PgDn / arrows
wywf.map.borders_help: Toggle biome borders and faint upper-biome outlines in cave view
wywf.map.distances_help: Toggle distances from the search center to known structure candidates
wywf.map.caves_source: Bright: cave biomes at the selected Y. Dim background and faint outlines: non-cave biome reference above the slice; generated surface blocks are a separate layer.
wywf.map.advice_help: These changes may make the search easier. Nothing changes until you choose. A match is not guaranteed.
wywf.map.advice_conflict: Review conflicting conditions; choose a specific change below.
wywf.map.advice_none: No safe simplification available. Review unknown words first.
wywf.map.verify_working: Generating locally · 2 background workers · bounded chunk/time budget
wywf.map.surface_fit: Location fit: green matches more nearby conditions; red matches fewer
wywf.map.verify_before_create: Run local verification before entering. Incomplete verification is not PASS.
wywf.map.offline_warning: The conditions are not fully confirmed. Create a regular world with this seed without a PASS verdict?
wywf.map.layer_temperature_help: Base biome temperature: −0.5..2.0, blue → red. Not В°C; no height shading.
wywf.map.layer_height_help: Height of the top visible block, including water, leaves and snow. Contours every 16 blocks.
wywf.map.layer_slope_help: Ground terrain steepness before trees and buildings. This overview uses vanilla base terrain.
wywf.map.layer_climate_help: Generator temperature noise at Y=64: gradual transitions, blue → red. Not В°C; no height shading.
wywf.map.climate_range: Local scale: %.4f → %.4f · blue → red · not В°C
wywf.map.finalizing_help: The results will contain only worlds that meet the conditions
wywf.map.overview: Dominant biomes, step %d; zoom in for terrain detail
wywf.map.finalizing_incomplete: Conditions could not be fully checked. Try Simplify query.
wywf.map.surface_help: Wheel / drag · contours show height steps · overview terrain is estimated
wywf.map.relief_context_help: Right-click the map for local 3D view
wywf.map.surface_coverage: Exact area: %d × %d b · cell %d b; outside: no generated blocks
wywf.map.example_help: Generate a different example map; the search query stays the same
wywf.map.query_error_help: Check conditions, operators and brackets. Fixes are applied only when chosen.
wywf.map.biome_overview: Biome overview; interpolated base terrain, before structures and features
wywf.map.structures_help: Structures appear after server confirmation. Generated features load around the view. Clear restores the search layers.
wywf.map.illustrated_heat: Temperature of source seed %d; sketch biomes are edited
wywf.map.fitting_seed: Fitting an example (up to 5 s) · seed %d
wywf.map.layer_match_help: Location fit: green means more supported nearby biome and structure conditions match. Uses the whole visible map; this preview does not replace final verification.
wywf.map.layer_water_help: Rivers, oceans, ice and shores. Cyan: shallow water, dark blue: depth, sand: shoreline. Overview uses biomes and estimated terrain, not exact water blocks.
wywf.map.layer_surface_help: Actual top blocks of the generated area. Generate here expands the area to 160×160 blocks.
wywf.map.layer_biomes_help: Distinct biome colors, borders and estimated relief. Scroll to zoom, drag to move.
wywf.map.water_overview: Cyan: shallows · blue: depth · sand: coast · estimated overview
wywf.map.loot_one_chest: All requested items must be in one chest of this structure
wywf.map.loot_help: Leave empty to remove this condition. Vanilla verifies loot after filtering.
wywf.map.loot_absent: %s is absent from the chest loot tables for %s in the selected world data.
wywf.map.loot_too_many: %s: requested %d. One chest can contain at most %d, one roll at most %d, and one slot holds %d.
wywf.map.loot_bound_help: Upper bounds do not guarantee a drop. Different chests are never added together.
wywf.map.saved_anchor: %s: confirmed bounds X/Z %d, %d to %d, %d; distance %d blocks
wywf.map.saved_open_help: View this world's map and original search
wywf.map.saved_unavailable: Select a world with a compatible WyWF map
wywf.map.saved_details: Original search and findings saved when this world was created
wywf.map.saved_snapshot: Snapshot recorded during the original search
wywf.map.preview_open_help: Explore the selected world in 2D and 3D before entering
wywf.map.candidate_details_hint: Open Details to see all matched conditions
wywf.map.saved_legacy: Older save: no search details or chunk snapshot
wywf.map.loot_count_help: Remove the chest loot condition to count structures
wywf.map.loot_limit: Upper limits: %d per chest, %d per roll, %d per slot
wywf.map.loot_incomplete: The table cannot be fully bounded. Manual input and vanilla verification remain available.
wywf.map.history_offline_help: Show saved candidates and their previous checks without running a new search. You can verify unchecked candidates from the results.
wywf.map.history_help: Show saved candidates for the current world settings. Seeds that already passed keep their confirmation, and unchecked seeds can be verified without a new search.
wywf.map.climate_overview: Vanilla generator temperature noise across the overview
wywf.map.slope_overview: Slope: estimated terrain; actual top blocks inside the generated area
wywf.map.obstacle: In the checks performed, %s rejected %s of %s attempts. Simplify can suggest changes.
wywf.map.ftp_pick_center: Click the map to pick a center. Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom.
wywf.map.ftp_area_help: Drag with the left button to select an area. Double right-click clears it.
wywf.map.ftp_area_limit: Zoom in or select an area up to %s blocks across.
wywf.map.ftp_loaded_help: Searches chunks already loaded by the game. Zoom in or select a smaller area.
wywf.map.ftp_query_overworld: Open the Overworld to use a text query.
wywf.map.ftp_bad_group: Enter 2–8 objects and a gap of 1–%s blocks.
wywf.map.ftp_overworld: Search for this feature in the Overworld.
wywf.map.relief_cave_wait: Reading actual blocks at this height…
wywf.map.relief_chunks_waiting: Chunk loading stalled · no progress for %s s
wywf.map.relief_chunks_warning: Some chunks failed to load · trying again
wywf.map.relief_chunks_failed: Loading error · %s chunks missing · see latest.log
wywf.map.live_map_help: Open the map at your position
wywf.map.live_explore: Visited chunks · explore to fill in the map
wywf.map.relief_controls: Left drag to rotate · Right drag to pan · Scroll to zoom
wywf.map.ftp_world_help: Click the map to set the starting point. The search expands outward until it finds a match or you stop it.
wywf.map.ftp_query_help: Enter a condition and search the selected or visible area.
wywf.map.ftp_survey_help: Right-drag to pan. Double right-click clears the area. Scroll to zoom.
wywf.map.ftp_help: FTP checks grid points on this seed with the selected generation settings. Smaller spacing checks more places. Results give coordinates; the world spawn stays unchanged.
wywf.map.ftp_unknown: Some words were not understood. Edit the conditions.
wywf.map.surface_end_blocks: Top blocks: %d chunks · estimated islands beyond generated terrain
wywf.map.surface_chunks: Top blocks: %d chunks; biome overview beyond generated terrain
wywf.map.obstacle_pinned: This condition is pinned and will not be changed.
wywf.map.edit_range_invalid: Use a minimum of 0 or more and a maximum from 64 to 4096; minimum must not exceed maximum
wywf.map.loot_no_items: No available items match the filter
wywf.map.loot_no_containers: This structure has no supported loot containers
wywf.map.loot_not_here: %s cannot appear in this container. Remove it or choose another container.
wywf.map.loot_count_invalid: Enter an item quantity from 1 to 4096
wywf.map.loot_select_first: Choose an item or a specific container
wywf.map.end_return_gateway_help: Shows confirmed return destinations. Explore more terrain or move the preview to the outer islands.
wywf.map.coverage_overview: Condition coverage over the visible map
wywf.map.edit_query_help: Edit the original conditions. Search again keeps your generation settings.
wywf.map.search_impossible: This query cannot be satisfied: the conditions conflict.
wywf.map.conflict_absence: The same target is required where another condition forbids it.
wywf.map.conflict_distance: The nearest matching object cannot satisfy both distance ranges.
wywf.map.conflict_count: These conditions require incompatible counts in the same area.
wywf.map.conflict_spawn: The block under the spawn point cannot be both of these blocks.
wywf.map.conflict_logic: No combination can satisfy this logical expression.
wywf.map.search_exhausted: No verified world was found within this search budget. This does not prove that the query is impossible.
wywf.map.search_failure_partial: A candidate could not be fully verified. Unconfirmed conditions: %s
wywf.map.search_failure_error: Verification stopped because of a technical problem: %s
wywf.map.search_failure_condition: A checked world did not satisfy: %s
wywf.map.search_failure_unknown: No precise rejection reason was recorded for this attempt.
wywf.map.search_failure_actions: Simplify a condition, edit the query, or start another search.
wywf.constructor.unsaved_body: Your changes to this condition have not been saved.
wywf.map.raw_map_help: Explore the candidate in 2D or 3D. Terrain is generated when you open the map.
wywf.map.marker_lock_help: Shift + click to lock or unlock
wywf.map.loot_in_biome: Checks the biome at the chest
wywf.map.seed_query_manual: Manual query · map edits do not change it
wywf.map.candidate_preview_missing: The verified preview is unavailable. You can still copy the seed.
